logo:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: standalone logo PNG for a Russian gaming highlights YouTube channel named Кузня Клипов (Clip Forge). This is the MASTER emblem, later reused in its avatar and banner.
Create one distinctive, exceptionally clean compact geometric ANVIL emblem with a right-facing PLAY triangle cut out of its main body in negative space. The shape should feel forged and fast, using a few purposeful angular facets, wide anvil top with a pointed horn on the left, short sturdy waist, broad stable foot. It must read as one designed symbol, not a pile of separate gaming icons. Bold silhouette legible at 40 px.
Palette: vivid Twitch-adjacent violet #9146FF and a restrained pale lavender edge #D9C3FF. Two or three solid color planes, near-flat, crisp precise edges; premium contemporary gaming editorial brand, restrained, not a stock esports mascot.
Composition: centered emblem occupying about 70% of a square 1024 x 1024 canvas, generous uniform clear space, no clipped tips.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha, no background rectangle, no checkerboard baked in. The play cutout is transparent too.
No letters, no text, no wordmark, no small decorative symbols, no sparks, no controller, no headset, no face, no mockup, no watermark. Output only the finished logo asset.
avatar:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: FINAL square YouTube profile avatar for Кузня Клипов, 1024 x 1024.
Input image 1 is the approved MASTER LOGO / edit target. Preserve its exact recognizable violet anvil silhouette, right-facing play cutout and facet geometry. Reproduce the same emblem cleanly, do not create a new shape.
Create an avatar using this emblem alone on a solid near-black graphite #0E0C14 square background with just a very faint local deep-purple illumination behind it. Compact violet #9146FF emblem with pale lavender top facets, sharp clean edge, no additional shapes. Scale the complete emblem to 66 percent of square width and center it horizontally and vertically. Crucial: generous margins so the entire anvil survives a circular profile crop and remains legible at 40px. Flat background, no ring, no border, no square badge, no text, no letters, no sparkles, no stars, no shadow extending toward the frame. Final standalone upload image, not a mockup.
banner:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: FINAL full YouTube channel banner artwork for Кузня Клипов, a Russian channel of short highlights from gaming livestreams. Generate a 2560 x 1440 pixel landscape image, 16:9, at least 2048 x 1152. This is the finished upload image, not a mockup or brand board.
Input image 1 is the channel's approved MASTER LOGO reference: reuse its recognizable violet anvil with play-shaped negative space, same silhouette and facets. Do not invent a second logo.
Art direction: contemporary premium gaming editorial identity, disciplined typography and generous negative space. Near-black graphite #0E0C14 backdrop, restrained deep-purple architectural facets and fast angular bands at the far sides, bright violet #9146FF as one controlled accent. Very subtle linear traces suggesting cut video frames and a timeline, abstract and integrated, no UI widgets or tiny labels. More graphic design than concept art.
CRITICAL COMPOSITION: YouTube crops this artwork to a narrow horizontal stripe. All meaningful content must fit together within the centered area x=580..1980, y=570..865 on the 2560x1440 canvas. Put the compact logo to the left of the title inside this area. The main title on ONE LINE to its right, then one small tagline below the title. Keep the entire lockup centered overall. Plenty of empty atmospheric graphite above and below. Outer edges are decoration only. No text near top or bottom.
Text (verbatim, Cyrillic): main title "КУЗНЯ КЛИПОВ". Small tagline "Моменты игровых стримов".
Main title large bold condensed modern sans serif, off-white, precise clean Cyrillic letterforms, no italics, no fake 3D, no distress. Tagline regular neutral sans, lavender-gray, highly legible. Do not misspell. No other words.
Avoid: game characters, streamers' faces, copied esports crests, controllers, giant headphones, guns, fire, clutter, rainbow gradients, stock neon city, web browser frames, slogans about upload frequency, Twitch/YouTube corporate logos, crop guides, dimension labels, watermark. Keep texture restrained so PNG stays below 6 MB.
bannerFinal:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit the supplied finished banner. Keep its design, logo, Cyrillic wording, typography, violet/graphite palette and all detail unchanged.
Required correction: This is a FULL 16:9 YouTube banner canvas, NOT a panoramic banner strip. Deliver a 2560 by 1440 pixel PNG (or at least 2048 by 1152 pixels). Full 16:9 aspect ratio is mandatory.
Extend the dark graphite background substantially upward and downward. Keep the existing horizontal artwork centered vertically, preserve proportions. Do not stretch the anvil or letters. Place the existing complete logo + title + tagline in the central safe stripe, with generous margins.
The main title and logo together must stay in the centered middle 55% of image width and middle 22% of image height. Text exactly "КУЗНЯ КЛИПОВ" and "Моменты игровых стримов". No new text, no labels, no visible crop guides. Empty dark canvas above and below is intentional, not something to crop away. Keep small decorative imagery away from central typography.
Output the COMPLETE tall 16:9 2560x1440 upload canvas with its dark upper and lower expanses intact.
